# stR

The goal of stR is to provide two methods for decomposing seasonal data:
STR (a Seasonal-Trend decomposition procedure based on Regression) and
Robust STR. In some ways, STR is similar to Ridge Regression and Robust
STR can be related to LASSO. They allow for multiple seasonal
components, multiple linear covariates with constant, flexible and
seasonal influence. Seasonal patterns (for both seasonal components and
seasonal covariates) can be fractional and flexible over time; moreover
they can be either strictly periodic or have a more complex topology.
The methods provide confidence intervals for the estimated components.
The methods can also be used for forecasting.

## Installation

You can install the **release** version from CRAN.

``` r

install.packages('stR')
```

You can install the **development** version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/robjhyndman/stR).

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
devtools::install_github("robjhyndman/stR")
```

## Example

For most users, the
[`AutoSTR()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/AutoSTR.md)
function will be the preferred way of using the package.

``` r

library(stR)
```

``` r

# Decomposition of a multiple seasonal time series
decomp <- AutoSTR(calls)
plot(decomp)
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-1.png)

``` r


# Decomposition of a monthly time series
decomp <- AutoSTR(log(grocery))
plot(decomp)
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-2.png)

See the vignette for more advanced options.

# Package index

## Functions to fit STR models

- [`AutoSTR()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/AutoSTR.md) :
  Automatic STR decomposition for time series data
- [`STR()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/STR.md) :
  Automatic STR decomposition
- [`STRmodel()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/STRmodel.md)
  : STR decomposition
- [`RSTRmodel()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/RSTRmodel.md)
  : Robust STR decomposition
- [`heuristicSTR()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/heuristicSTR.md)
  : Automatic STR decomposition with heuristic search of the parameters

## Functions that work with STR objects

- [`components()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/components.md)
  : Extract STR components
- [`seasadj(`*`<STR>`*`)`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/seasadj.STR.md)
  : Seasonal adjustment based on STR
- [`plot(`*`<STR>`*`)`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/plot.STR.md)
  : Plots the results of decomposition
- [`plotBeta()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/plotBeta.md)
  : Plots the varying beta coefficients of decomposition

## Data

- [`calls`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/calls.md) : Number
  of phone calls dataset
- [`electricity`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/electricity.md)
  : Electricity consumption dataset
- [`grocery`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/stR/reference/grocery.md) :
  Grocery and supermarkets turnover
